label: Every actual CONCRETE_6 individual grounds itself, from reflexive dependence
meaning: On the reflexive reading, STMT-ACTUAL-DEPENDENCE-IS-GROUNDING, which has no distinctness condition, makes every actual concretum ground itself; with irreflexive actual grounding (or, through STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-IS-SIMPLE-PRIORITY, with irreflexive simple priority) this is inconsistent as soon as one actual concretum exists (elementary; that last step is not separately certified). So the #1590 route DependsForBeing to grounds to PriorSimply needs either the strict reading of D or the distinct-relata restriction of its first bridge.
